title: wiri IPC protocol
description: wiri IPC 1.3: adjacent-tagged IpcMessage/IpcEvent and external NiriRequest/NiriReply/NiriEvent dialects. One UTF-8 JSON value per line, multiple requests per connection. The per-user/session named pipe is \\.\pipe\wiri_control_<user>_<session>; WIRI_PIPE overrides it. Unknown fields are generally ignored; unsupported variants and invalid fields return recoverable errors. Output actions validate strictly.

WindowInfoIpc.description: Per-window data returned by window_opened events and window_list responses.

WindowLayoutIpc.description: Logical geometry before offscreen parking; sizes and offsets use output-scale logical pixels. window_size includes native Win32 decorations, not wiri's inset.

FocusTimestamp.description: Daemon-local monotonic duration since startup; null until managed-window focus is observed. Not wall time or comparable across restarts.

KeyboardLayoutsIpc.description: Loaded layouts in OS order and foreground-thread index. Empty list uses index 0; names are localized when available, otherwise an honest HKL label.

x.description: Engine origin in Windows virtual-desktop coordinates.

width.description: Output width divided by layout scale, rounded.

OutputIpc.description: Active Windows output. Unknown hardware fields (including VRR/max_bpc) are null; absent identity strings are empty.

oneOf.description: Width and height in millimetres.

current_mode.description: Index into modes, or null when no current mode was reported.

oneOf.description: SDR desktop sRGB only; HDR conversion is not supported.

WindowIpc.description: A window as the event stream describes it: niri's Window, plus what wiri adds (class_name, output, is_fullscreen, is_maximized, is_minimized).

id.description: The window handle (HWND) as a number; what --id takes in run_action.

title.description: The title; null while the window has none.

app_id.description: File name of the window's program (WindowsTerminal.exe); null when it cannot be read.

workspace_id.description: The workspace the window is on (WorkspaceIpc.id).

is_focused.description: The window has the keyboard focus.

output.description: Device name of the monitor the window is on (\\.\DISPLAY1).

is_maximized.description: Maximized to the edges of the work area (niri maximize-window-to-edges).

WorkspaceIpc.description: A workspace as the event stream describes it: niri's Workspace.

id.description: Unique among all workspaces of all monitors, stable while the workspace exists, small enough for a JavaScript number.

idx.description: Number of the workspace on its monitor, counted from 1 at the top: what focus-workspace 2 means.

output.description: Device name of the monitor the workspace is on.

is_active.description: The active workspace of its monitor.

is_focused.description: The active workspace of the focused monitor.

name.description: Windows device name of the monitor (\\.\DISPLAY1), as open-on-output names it; empty when the engine was not told.

bounds_x.description: Left edge of physical screen rect.

bounds_y.description: Top edge of physical screen rect.

active_workspace.description: Active workspace id on this monitor.

focused.description: True for the focused output (where new windows go).

SuccessResponse.description: Generic success response with no result payload.

WorkspacesResponse.description: The result of the workspaces request: the workspaces of every monitor, in niri's shape.

WindowsResponse.description: The result of the windows request: every window wiri manages, in niri's shape.

FocusedWindowResponse.description: The result of the focused_window request: the focused window, or null when no managed window has the focus.

OverviewStateResponse.description: The result of the overview_state request.

is_open.description: True while the overview is open.

VersionResponse.description: The result of the version request: the version of the running daemon.

version.description: The crate version, and the commit it was built from when there is one.

ErrorResponse.description: Error response returned when the daemon cannot fulfil a request.

IpcResponse.description: Top-level response wrapper for all one-shot requests.

ColumnWidthPreset.description: Column width preset for set_column_width. Aliases: quarter=1/4, third=1/3, half=1/2, etc.

PositionChange.description: Logical-pixel or percentage-point position change. SetFixed is relative to the working-area origin; proportions use the full working-area dimension (50 means 50%). Signed CLI values adjust. Proportional results clamp to 0..10000 before visibility clamping.

MoveFloatingWindow.description: IPC/CLI-only positioning. Omitted axes mean AdjustFixed(0). Floating targets retain 10..75 logical pixels of partial visibility; tiled targets update stored floating position and require both axes absolute unless stored/default position exists. Does not focus or switch workspace. An active move blocks implicit or matching targets, permitting other explicit IDs.

id.description: Managed window HWND; null or omitted selects the focused window.

WorkspaceReferenceArg.description: Typed JSON workspace reference. Id is lossless u64 and resolves current WorkspaceIpc.id globally, following the workspace object through rename, reorder and monitor relocation. Valid absent IDs are handled no-ops without fallback, mutation or focus; invalid typed IDs return Err. Index is an output-local visible position; Name is a global string name, including numeric strings. CLI/KDL retain index/name syntax and expose no Id spelling.

Id.description: Unsigned 64-bit JSON integer; clients must preserve exact integer precision. Strings, negative, fractional and overflowing values are errors. Runtime serde also rejects float encodings such as 42.0; JSON Schema's mathematical integer semantics cannot enforce that lexical restriction.

NullableWorkspaceReferenceArg.description: Omitted or null selects the focused workspace; otherwise the explicit typed reference selects the workspace.

MoveWindowToWorkspace.description: Move a window to a typed workspace reference. Index is local to the window's output; Id and Name are global. focus=false does not follow the transferred window to its destination. Unknown valid workspace IDs are handled without mutation or focus.

window_id.description: Managed window HWND; omitted/null selects the focused window. Explicit handles must fit the native handle range.

id.description: Alias for window_id; send only one spelling.

index.description: Destination visible position; clamps to the finite workspace stack and must fit the daemon's usize.

WorkspaceIpcAction.description: Lossless transport for the seven typed workspace actions. Payloads tolerate unknown future fields; required and optional known fields retain their declared JSON types.

IpcSizeChange.description: Typed size change for SetColumnWidth, SetWindowWidth and SetWindowHeight. Fixed values are signed i32 logical pixels; proportions are finite percentage points (50 means 50%, 0.1 means 0.1%). The engine rounds proportions to 0.001 percentage points and saturates the resulting thousandths to signed i32 before layout constraints apply. Negative and zero values retain their Set/Adjust kind; layout constraints may clamp the resulting allocation. Runtime serde rejects float-encoded Fixed values such as 160.0; JSON Schema's mathematical integer semantics cannot enforce that lexical restriction.

TypedSizeActionFields.description: Required typed change; optional id/window_id selects a managed window, omitted/null means focused window. SetWindowWidth and SetWindowHeight target directly without focusing; Wiri's optional ID extension on SetColumnWidth retains legacy focus-before-action behavior. Unknown future fields are tolerated. focus=false is unsupported.

id.description: Positive managed HWND fitting the daemon's native handle range.

window_id.description: Alias for id; send only one spelling.

NiriRequest.description: Externally tagged requests; supported typed Action and Output variants use PascalCase. Unknown requests receive Err without disconnecting.

NiriEvent.description: External event names; data has the corresponding IpcEvent data shape (including additive wiri window fields). Wiri-only variants are omitted.

IpcMessage.description: Any request sent from a client to the wiri daemon.

command.description: The program, or (when args is empty) a whole command line split with the Windows quoting rules.

args.description: Arguments, each passed through intact. Optional.

oneOf.description: Run any action by its niri name, as if its key were pressed (also accepted with type "action" and the name under "action").

args.description: The words after the action name in a binds line; a number or a boolean stands for its text. niri's --id <hwnd> (or --window-id) names the window to act on. Optional.

quoted.description: quoted[i] says that args[i] was written in double quotes: focus-workspace 2 is the second workspace, focus-workspace "2" the workspace named 2. Optional.

niri Workspaces: the workspaces of every monitor, in niri's shape. Answered from the engine's current state.
niri Windows: the windows wiri manages, in niri's shape. Answered from the engine's current state.
niri FocusedWindow: the window that has the keyboard focus, in niri's shape (null when no managed window has it).
niri OverviewState: whether the overview is open.
niri Version: the version of the running daemon.

IpcEvent.description: Any event emitted by the wiri daemon to active subscribe_events subscribers. A new subscriber is first told the state: workspaces_changed, windows_changed, overview_opened_or_closed, keyboard_layouts_changed and config_loaded, in that order (niri's event stream), then what changes.

oneOf.description: A screenshot was copied to the clipboard; path is null for clipboard-only or when saving failed.
niri WorkspacesChanged: the workspaces were created, removed, renamed, moved or reordered. The full list replaces what the client knew.
niri WorkspaceUrgencyChanged: a window of the workspace asked for attention, or the last one that did stopped.
niri WorkspaceActiveWindowChanged: the window that is the active one of the workspace changed.
niri WindowsChanged: every window wiri manages; replaces what the client knew. Part of what a new subscriber is told first.

niri WindowOpenedOrChanged: a window appeared, or its title, application, workspace, floating state, fullscreen, maximized or minimized state changed. Focus, urgency and the place in the strip have events of their own.
niri WindowFocusChanged: the window that has the keyboard focus changed (null: a window wiri does not manage has it, or none).
niri WindowUrgencyChanged: the window asks for attention, or stopped.
niri WindowLayoutsChanged: the places of windows in their strips changed.
niri OverviewOpenedOrClosed.
Emitted when a new window is added to the tiling engine.
niri WindowClosed: a window wiri managed is gone, destroyed or taken out of the layout. window_hwnd and id are the same number.

id.description: Same as window_hwnd; niri's name for it.

oneOf.description: niri WorkspaceActivated: the workspace became the active one of its monitor. focused: it is now the focused workspace (the active one of the focused monitor). Also sent when the focus moves to another monitor.
Emitted when the config file is loaded or hot-reloaded.

config_path.description: Absolute path of the config file.

failed.description: True when the file has errors: it was not applied and the last good config stays in use.

error.description: When failed: file:line:column: error: message of the first error.

warnings.description: How many things in the file wiri ignores.

Emitted when the focused output (monitor) changes.

monitor_name.description: OS display name of the newly focused monitor.

x.description: New left edge in screen pixels.

y.description: New top edge in screen pixels.

width.description: New client width in physical pixels.

height.description: New client height in physical pixels.

Emitted when the active workspace on a monitor changes.

column_index.description: Zero-based column index within the workspace.
